options.name: Simulation length
options.description: Choose whether to set the simulation length based on the energy decay threshold (EDT) or by impulse response length.

options.name: Energy decay threshold
options.description: The energy decay threshold for determining the simulation length. Once the energy decays below this threshold, the simulation will terminate. (Only used if 'Simulation length' is set to 'EDT'.)

options.name: Impulse response length
options.description: The maximum length of the impulse response to be simulated. (Only used if 'Simulation length' is set to 'IR length'.)

options.name: Speed of sound
options.description: Speed of sound in the room.

options.name: Characteristic length (mesh)
options.description: Characteristic length of the mesh used in the simulation, i.e. the average edge length of mesh elements.
